key_highlights: ASX ended a volatile week higher but slumped on RBA rate-hike calls; Qantas lifted while Wesfarmers and Sigma sold off (#26, #38)
Strong household spending and persistent housing inflation heap pressure on RBA to hike, complicating the rate path (#64, #72)
Housing market under stress: auction sentiment deteriorating, 'perfect storm' warnings for value declines (#60, #63, #71)
Qantas profits dip to four-year low; fare hikes and Jetstar fee expansion likely; sacked workers face unemployment (#32, #44)
Gateway Resources adds 7km gold trend in WA; Pilbara mining activity booms (#30, #65)
Fed's Warsh signals rate hikes may be needed amid sticky US inflation, pressuring global risk assets (#56, #69)
Nvidia earnings reignite AI boom confidence; data centre energy policy debate intensifies in Australia (#51, #27, #61)
Consumer trends: weight-loss drug demand surges, EV uptake accelerates, 'dupe' brand loyalty grows (#41)

sectors.trend: Positive. Gateway Resources' 7km gold discovery in WA and Pilbara production boom support sector sentiment. Gold trend adds to existing WA zone, attracting exploration capital.
sectors.implications: Gold miners (GOLD.AX, NVA.AX) and WA-focused juniors benefit. BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX stable on iron ore but watch AUD strength. X2M and Metal Hawk among ASX runners of the week.

sectors.trend: Under pressure. RBA rate-hike calls and strong household spending raise credit-risk concerns. Housing 'perfect storm' warnings threaten NPL trajectories. Sigma slumped on rate-hike fears.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face margin compression if RBA hikes into a weakening housing cycle. Sigma (SIG.AX) volatility elevated. Monitor NPL data and housing credit growth.

sectors.trend: Negative. Qantas profits at four-year low; fare hikes and Jetstar fee expansion signal margin stress. Sacked workers face unemployment. Virgin (QNT.AX) shielded by fuel hedging and new fleet.
sectors.implications: QAN.AX under pressure; fare hikes may dampen demand. WES.AX slumped. Consumer staples (WOW.AX, WES.AX) see 'dupe' brand shift pressuring premium margins. EV uptake accelerates,利好 battery names.

sectors.trend: Mixed. Victoria doubles down on a 'worst renewable energy option' (likely large-scale storage or specific tech). Data centre fossil-fuel power debate creates policy uncertainty. Critical Resources taps CSIRO for battery scale-up.
sectors.implications: Energy transition names (SOL.AX, LIT.AX) face policy risk. Battery/critical minerals (CRS.AX, LIT.AX) gain from CSIRO partnership. Data centre energy demand (AGL.AX, CGP.AX) is a structural tailwind but policy-restricted.

sectors.trend: Positive. Weight-loss drug demand surging in Australia. Health insurance rebate changes weigh on older consumers. CSL remains a defensive anchor.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX benefits from global biotech demand. Domestic pharma and health services see volume upside from GLP-1 drugs. Rebate changes may pressure HIC.AX and private health insurers.

sectors.trend: Negative. Housing 'perfect storm' warnings, auction sentiment deterioration, and household terminations signal a property downturn. Student accommodation at $440k/bed shows froth.
sectors.implications: Property REITs (GPW.AX, DGL.AX, ICV.AX) face cap-rate expansion risk. Residential construction (WBC.AX exposure) under pressure. Student housing (SPG.AX) valuations stretched.

Housing market correction risk: auction declines, 'perfect storm' narrative, household terminations
Qantas/aviation sector profitability crisis and labour disputes
Gold and Pilbara mining strength; WA exploration upside
AI/data centre energy policy debate (fossil fuel 'high bar')
Fed rate-hike signal (Warsh) creating global risk-off pressure
Consumer shift: weight-loss drugs, EVs, dupe brands, cost-consciousness
Battery tech and critical minerals scale-up via CSIRO partnerships

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA forced into rate hikes amid housing downturn
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight financials with strong capital buffers (CBA.AX, NAB.AX); underweight rate-sensitive REITs and residential builders
Reduce exposure to property REITs (GPW.AX, DGL.AX); favour income-generating infrastructure REITs; monitor auction clearance rates weekly

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Fed rate hike (Warsh signal) triggers global risk-off and AUD weakness
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge AUD exposure; favour domestic-revenue companies; monitor AUD/USD and 10-yr GBA yields

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Qantas/aviation sector contagion and consumer confidence hit
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid QAN.AX near-term; monitor Jetstar fee backlash; favour Virgin (QNT.AX) on hedging advantage

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Data centre energy policy uncertainty disrupts capex plans
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour diversified energy generators (AGL.AX, CGP.AX) over single-asset exposure; watch federal policy announcements

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and WA exploration names
opportunities.rationale: Gateway's 7km gold trend and Pilbara boom signal sustained commodity demand; gold hedges rate-hike and housing-risk scenarios

opportunities.recommendation: Favour Virgin Australia over Qantas on margin resilience

opportunities.recommendation: Position in defensive healthcare (CSL) amid rate uncertainty
opportunities.rationale: Weight-loss drug demand surge and global biotech pipeline provide earnings visibility; CSL.AX is a low-beta anchor in volatile markets

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce property REIT and residential builder exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Auction sentiment deterioration, 'perfect storm' housing narrative, and household terminations signal a correction; cap-rate expansion risk elevated

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge rate-hike risk in financials; favour capital-strong banks
defensive_moves.rationale: RBA may be forced to hike into a weakening housing cycle, compressing NIMs and raising NPLs; CBA and NAB have stronger loss-absorbing capacity

defensive_moves.recommendation: Monitor AUD/USD and GBA 10-yr yield for Fed-driven volatility
defensive_moves.rationale: Warsh's rate-hike signal and sticky US inflation could trigger a global risk-off; AUD weakness pressures ASX miners' reported earnings

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain volatile. Rate-hike calls and housing stress cap upside, but mining strength and defensive healthcare provide a floor. Qantas and consumer names are near-term drags. Expect ^AXJO to trade in a narrow range with elevated VIX. Key watch: RBA commentary and US CPI/Fed Warsh signals.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook is cautiously constructive if RBA navigates the housing-inflation dilemma without triggering a credit event. Gold, critical minerals, and AI-infrastructure energy demand are structural tailwinds. Housing correction risk is the primary downside scenario. Consumer shift toward value ('dupe' brands, cost-consciousness) pressures premium names but supports staples.
